senses.gloss:
रोच रोच, अस्, आ, अम् (fr. rt. 1. रुच्), en-
lightening, illuminating, one who lightens or makes
bright; (अस्), m., N. of a king; [cf. गो-र्˚.]

रोचक, अस्, आ, अम्, brightening, enlightening,
&c. (= रोचन); giving an appetite, (अ-रोचक,
taking away appetite, depriving of appetite); pleas-
ing, agreeable; (अस्), m. hunger, appetite; a sto-
machic, stimulant, any medicine, fruit, &c. supposed
to strengthen the tone of the stomach and restore
lost appetite; N. of various plants, the plantain; a
kind of onion; a worker in glass or artificial orna-
ments.

रोचकिन्, ई, इनी, इ, having desire or appetite;
अ-रोचकिन्, free from desire or appetite.

रोचन, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, enlightening, making
bright, illuminating, irradiating, lightening, light,
bright, splendid, beautiful; causing or exciting de-
sire, giving pleasure or satisfaction, pleasing, agree-
able, pleasant, charming, lovely; sharpening or giving
an appetite, stomachic; (अस्), m. a stomachic; a
variety of the cotton tree; = पलाण्डु, आरग्-बध,
करञ्ज, अङ्कोठ, दाडिम; epithet of a demon
presiding over a particular disease; N. of one of the
five arrows of the god of love (‘exciter of pleasures’);
N. of a son of Viṣṇu by Dakṣiṇā; N. of Indra
under Manu Svārociṣa; of a mountain; (आ), f. the
bright sky, firmament, (see रोचनम् below); a
handsome woman; a particular yellow pigment (com-
monly called गो-रोचना, q. v.); a red lotus-flower;
dark Śālmali (= Marāṭhī kāḷī sāmvarī) = वंश-
रोचना, bamboo manna or Tabāṣīr; N. of a wife
of Vasu-deva; (ई), f., N. of various plants, Convol-
vulus Turpethum; = काम्पिल्ल; = दन्ति; = आम-
लकी; red arsenic, realgar; a particular yellow pig-
ment, = रोचना; (अम्), n. light, brightness (Ved.),
the bright sky, firmament, luminous sphere (of which
there are said to be three, see Ṛg-veda I. 102, 8;
in this sense sometimes आ, f.); a luminary (Ved.);
the raising a desire for; देवानां रोचनम्, N. of
a Sāman.
—रोचन-फल, अस्, m. the citron tree;
(आ), f. a species of cucumber.
—रोचन-स्था, आस्, आस्,
अम्, Ved. abiding in light, dwelling in the firma-
ment.
—रोचना-कृ, see Gaṇa Sākṣādādi to Pāṇ.
I. 4, 74.
—रोचना-मुख, अस्, m., N. of a Daitya.
—रोचना-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessing light,
shining, light, bright.

रोचनक, अस्, m. the citron tree; (इका), f. a
species of plant (= शुण्डा-रोचनी, काम्पिल्लिका); =
वंश-रोचना, bamboo manna or Tabāṣīr.

रोचमान, अस्, आ, अम्, shining, glittering, bright,
splendid, resplendent; pleasing, gratifying, charming,
pleasant, agreeable, (अ-रोचमान, not agreeable,
unpleasant); (अस्), m. a tuft or curl of hair on a
horse's neck; N. of a king; of one of the Mātṛs
attending upon Skanda.
रोची, f. a pot-herb, Hingtsha Repens.
रोचिन्, ई, इनी, इ, light, bright, (see मित-र्˚.)

रोचिष, अस्, m. (fr. रोचिस्), N. of a son of Vibhā-
vasu by Uṣas.

रोचिष्णु, उस्, उस्, उ, shining, giving light, bright,
splendid, brilliant, beautiful, gaily adorned, elegantly
dressed, gay, blooming; giving an appetite.
—रो-
चिष्णु-मुख, अस्, आ or ई, अम्, having a bright
countenance.

रोचिस्, इस्, n. light, splendor, brightness, brilliancy,
flame.
—रोचिष्-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessing light,
giving light; (आन्), m., N. of a son of Manu Svāro-
cisha.

रोच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be illuminated or enlight-
ened.
